explanation.text: RFC 9110 requires that a server must not send a message body in a HEAD response, only the headers.
The HEAD method is defined to be identical to GET except that the server must not include a response body in the response.
Headers such as Content-Length in a HEAD response describe the body that would have been returned by a GET request, but the actual body is omitted.
